text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Brace yourself, Believe-san! No matter 
how impregnable the castle,
I shall pierce 
right through it!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Roar, "Holy Sword"! Yaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I—won't lose.
I've been building up toward 
this all this time... all this time!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Ghk... What is this tenacity... Users?!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"It's Believe! It's Believe!
It's Believe! 
Never giving up the lead, she crosses the 
finish line now!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant* I couldn't... press the 
attack to the end. As expected of 
Believe-san.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
To think she deflected this 'Holy Sword.' 
However...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
A palpable sense of progress... It went 
just as I envisioned; no, it was an even 
more meaningful race than I had hoped.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Victory was out of reach. Yet Durandal 
still left behind a stellar result and a 
brilliant sparkle.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Believe-san, Light O-san, my deepest 
thanks. It's thanks to you two that I was 
able to run as well as I did today..."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
The unyielding pace they set revealed to 
me the exact moment to unleash the 
"Excalibur"...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
And thus, the sacred crest—was engraved 
within me.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"This mark will be the key to guiding me 
to victory in future sprints. Even in 
races without the two of them."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Looks like... she's grasped something.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of grasping something, I have 
too.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Huh, Light O-san, what are you doing?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
A hint for top speed. Durandal is fast. 
Believe is too. Which means—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Add both their speeds together and don't 
divide by two—maximum speed!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...Yes?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
So that I can run like that too. Well 
then, until we meet again.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Wait, Right O-san...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...And she's gone. We share a dorm room, 
so I know what an amazing Umamusume she 
is, but...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Her gaze is aimed entirely in the wrong 
direction. I wonder if the day will ever 
come when we cross swords again?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I wonder...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O sprinted away in a 
straight line. Thank you, Light O. 
Farewell, Light O.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono, it went just as you 
anticipated. By running alongside those 
two on a GⅠ stage...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
The "Holy Sword" seems to shine even 
brighter now. Enough to make an impact in 
sprint races as well.
choice_data_list: Yeah! That gives us a lot more opt...
Yeah! This really broadens our opt...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I am no longer an inexperienced 
knight.
choice_data_list: Yeah! That really opens up our opt...
Yeah! That opens up our options, too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As if blessing the two of them—

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Durandal and Trainer!! Today was 
amazing!!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! What an insane late burst!! People 
called her the ruler of a small nation 
before, but she's way beyond that level 
now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Surrounded by a circle of passionate
fans. 
We were—right at the center of that round 
table.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I never expected such a warm reception... 
It seems the "Holy Sword" has truly 
reached everyone's hearts.
choice_data_list: Yeah, you took a big gamble this time.
Yeah, because I took a big gamble ...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. To have so many people who 
appreciate that courage...
choice_data_list: Yeah, we really took a big gamble ...
Yeah, we took a big gamble this ti...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Please listen,
everyone. Just as you said, 
King <username> is no longer the ruler of
a small 
nation.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
You are truly a fine king! To have pulled 
off such a magnificent challenge!
choice_data_list: (This really is embarrassing...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheers far louder than ever before echoed 
relentlessly into the evening sky.
choice_data_list: (This is really embarrassing after...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Trainer-dono. A letter has arrived for us.
choice_data_list: By correspondence... do you mean f...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
No, it is an official letter. It was 
properly sealed with wax, and bore a 
signet ring impression as well.
choice_data_list: A missive...? You mean a fan letter?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Would you like to read it?
choice_data_list: Yeah, who on earth could it be fro...
Yeah. But who could it be from...?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Ah――! This is...
choice_data_list: Yeah, just who could it be from...?
Yeah, who on earth could it be fro...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"To my dearest Knight Durandal, and 
Trainer."

Good day.
I am glad to see you are in good 
health as ever. I watched your recent 
race. And there...

"There was a side of you I never knew. A 
splendid knight possessing dignity, 
manners, and the courage to face any 
hardship."

"Seeing you after so long made my heart 
tremble with the desire to spar. This 
time, not with swords, but in a race."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Having emerged from a season of hardship, 
I have managed to claim many victories. I 
pride myself on being a worthy opponent.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Well then, O knight, O king of the 
neighboring realm. I shall await you at 
the Mile Championship♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: From Fine Motion.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: A letter from the Princess, Trainer-dono!
choice_data_list: So it came from Fine Motion...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I have heard the rumors. While things 
stalled in the spring, she has been on a 
winning streak ever since.
choice_data_list: From Fine Motion, huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It seems she's viewed as one of the top 
contenders for the final leg of the
Triple 
Tiara, the 'Shuka Sho', this autumn."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono, it is an invitation from a 
benefactor— what shall we do?
choice_data_list: Let's definitely go see them!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I would love to meet them too! And 
offer my thanks once again.
choice_data_list: Let's definitely go meet them!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our next target race was decided. 
An audience with the gracious princess.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the 1600m GⅠ "Mile Championship" held 
in November, let's show everyone how 
splendidly Durandal has grown.
